summary: Sacks favors competition and open models over centralized AI control, opposes a national pause, and says each lab is responsible for its products.

statements.quote: A pause would not make America safer. It would hand the frontier to China.
The solution to AI-powered cyberattacks is AI-powered cyberdefense.
If the unreleased models are scary enough that you think you should slow down, I support your decision to be responsible.
Keeping innovation decentralized and accessible is the key to avoiding an unsafe and dystopian future where advanced AI capabilities are centralized and controlled by only a few hands.
This means that apocalyptic predictions of job loss are as overhyped as AGI itself.
